selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq v2, HiSeq 2000) of vastus lateralis biopsies at 1000 hr, baseline and 72 hr after the last bout of 12 weeks training (S4.4.1.p1, S1.p3)
selected.primary_estimand: within-subject change in muscle gene expression after 12 weeks of training (post vs pre), separately for each training mode (HIIT, RT, CT) within each age group (Young 18-30, Old 65-80) (S2.4.p1, FIG4 A-F)
planned_contrasts: Old HIIT post vs pre (FIG4B; paper: 553 genes increased, S2.4.p2/S2.6.p5)
Young RT post vs pre (FIG4C; 35% fewer up genes than young HIIT, S2.4.p1)
Old RT post vs pre (FIG4D; 70% fewer up genes than old HIIT, ~166)
Young CT post vs pre (FIG4E; 28% fewer up genes than young HIIT)
Old CT post vs pre (FIG4F; 84% fewer up genes than old HIIT, ~88)
Baseline Old vs Young (S2.4.p1; 267 lower + 166 higher in old = 433), associational
selected.repeated_measure_unit: participant (pre and post biopsy from the same person)
selected.inclusion: all participants with RNA-seq at both timepoints; CT pre-training = post-SED biopsy (B), the pre-SED (A) biopsy is not deposited
selected.paper_method: not stated for RNA-seq (MapRSeq pipeline, 'as previously described (Lanza et al., 2012)'); comparisons are per mode-by-age pre vs post

decisions.reason: S2.1.p2: randomized to HIIT/RT/CT within age groups; S1.p3 and S2.4.p1: RNA-seq at baseline and post-training; FIG4 A-F gives six training-induced DEG sets by mode and age; S4.4.1.p1 gives the threshold (FDR-corrected p <= 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 0.5). The DE software is not named. S2.4.p1 gives baseline age differences (267/166). Only up counts are reported for training contrasts.

candidates: raw_counts (confirm against provenance: normalized integers and rounded estimated counts look the same)

decisions.reason: All values integers, library sizes 14-72M; GEO data_processing: 'tab-delimited text files of raw reads per gene in each sample' (MapRSeq). Raw counts suit a negative-binomial model.

selected.analysis_type: paired pre/post within each age x mode stratum

decisions.reason: Each participant has pre and post biopsies (S2.1.p2: baseline and post-training studies in all participants); FIG4 A-F are post vs pre within each mode x age. Time is the factor, subject the blocking key, cohort a stratum. Baseline Old vs Young (S2.4.p1) is a cross-sectional associational comparison on pre-training biopsies.

covariates.name: subject
covariates.disposition: blocking term in every paired fit (~ subject + time)

covariates.name: batch
covariates.disposition: count-file/sequencing batch is constant within subject, so absorbed by subject in paired fits; added only in a sensitivity run of the unpaired baseline age comparison

decisions.reason: Repeated measures: pre and post from the same participant, so subject is blocked. The two deposited count files (different library depths) split subjects, not timepoints, so batch is nested in subject.

selected.method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2 Wald, ~ subject + time, per stratum, complete pairs)

paper_route.reason: the paper does not name its DE software; DESeq2 on raw counts with subject blocking is the validated route

deviations: DE software not named in paper; DESeq2 paired model used
paper may have analyzed all participants rather than complete pairs; we keep complete pairs only (Young CT subject 27 has no post sample)
